summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation has shifted from brittle CSS/XPath selectors toward LLM-driven extraction, natural language queries, and self-healing automation that adapts to page changes. Tools now combine headless browser control with AI agents that can understand page semantics, extract structured data, and perform tasks described in plain English. Developer adoption clusters around open-source frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer) augmented with AI, and purpose-built AI scraping APIs like Firecrawl and Apify.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source (cloud runners via third parties vary)
ai_features: Integrates with AI agents (MCP server for Playwright)
Supports LLM-driven automation via community tools
tools.best_for: Reliable cross-browser automation and testing, increasingly paired with AI agents

tools.name: Puppeteer
ai_features: Commonly combined with LLMs for extraction
Works with AI agent frameworks via CDP
tools.best_for: Chromium-based browser automation and scraping in Node.js

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Pay-as-you-go plus plans starting around $49/month (Starter); scale/enterprise tiers available
ai_features: LLM integrations and AI crawling tools
strengths: Strong SDK and Crawlee open-source library
tools.best_for: Deploying and scaling scrapers and automation workflows in the cloud

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with credits; paid plans start around $16/month (Hobby) up to Standard/Growth tiers
ai_features: AI-powered crawling and content cleaning for RAG
strengths: Turns websites into clean LLM-ready data
Popular in the AI/RAG developer community
tools.best_for: Feeding web data into LLMs and RAG pipelines

tools.name: Selenium
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source (grid hosting via third parties)
ai_features: Integrates with AI testing tools and self-healing locator add-ons
tools.best_for: Established browser automation and web testing at scale

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free developer tier; paid plans start around $20/month with scale/enterprise options
ai_features: Stagehand framework for natural-language/AI-driven browser actions
strengths: Managed headless browser infrastructure for agents
tools.best_for: Running AI agents and automations on managed cloud browsers

tools.name: Scrapy
